summary: Iter385 – Empresas Integradoras (padre) → Aplicativos (hijos) + Reel de Técnicos. Backend: 22/23 pytest passed (1 skipped: non-admin DELETE 403 – no valid non-admin creds; code check OK). Frontend: QA1 (Natural + Jurídica created via UI with 2 contacts, PDF/PNG RIF, search, Ficha, preview, download), QA2 (accordion expand/collapse, Ficha incompleta badge + filter, edit dialog with integrator-company-locked, move dialog, Agregar Aplicativo opens wizard preloaded), Proyectos de Integración tab regression, Project Detail cascade Empresa A-Z → Aplicativo + 3 technicians reel saved/displayed + suggestions + invalid-email toast, Direct Projects reel (3 techs, auto app) and Quote wizard labels all PASS. Found 1 functional UI bug (MoveAppDialog stale state), 1 migration data gap (contacts not copied from 'email'/contacts[]), and minor issues.

minor.issue: Only 42 of 380 migrated companies got a corporate contact. Migration only reads principal_contact_name/email/phone (44 records). It ignores the 'Correo de Contacto' field `email` (187 integrators have it, e.g. Pushve V1.0 has "'Aldo Materan' <aldo.materan1@gmail.com>") and the `contacts[]` array (158 integrators; 93 companies with no contact have apps that do have contacts[]). So 'Contacto Principal' shows '—' for most companies, which goes against the user's choice 'se copió el Contacto Principal'.

No unique indexes on rif / norm_name. The 409 uniqueness check is find-then-insert, so two requests at the same time can both get through. GET /api/integrator-companies runs link_orphan_integrators (writes during a read) and can create duplicate companies when 2 list calls run concurrently. Add unique (sparse/partial) indexes on rif and norm_name.

project_scope (new/component/expansion) is still worked out by exact-name regex before linking. A variant name like 'X, C.A.' vs 'X C.A' is grouped into the same company but is classified as 'new'. Consider classifying by norm_company/empresa instead.
Deleting the last app of an auto-created company leaves an empty 'Ficha incompleta' company behind (cleanup is manual). Not a bug, just to be aware of.
Only get_current_user, no RBAC permission check (pre-existing). Now also writes integrators.contacts through remember_technicians.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Cancelar' button calls onClose() but does not reset q/target (the reset only runs in onOpenChange on Esc/X). When the dialog reopens, even for a DIFFERENT app, it keeps the previous search and selected target, and 'Mover aplicativo' is already enabled. A misclick can move the wrong app. Reproduced: pick an option → Cancelar → reopen → confirm enabled, search='QA UI Juridica'.

If POST company succeeds but the RIF upload fails, an error toast shows and the dialog stays open. Saving again POSTs again → 409 duplicate RIF. After a successful create, it should switch to edit mode (company=data) or close and warn.
Esc does not close the PDF preview when focus is inside the iframe (closes fine for PNG and via the X button).

design_issues.screen: Project Detail → Implementación → Reel de Técnicos (pd-tech-*)
issues: The 4 inputs (name/phone/email/role) are squeezed into the narrow middle column. Values are cut off ('QA Tec', '04´', 'qa.tecr'). Stack them in 2 rows or use 2 columns.

Migration grouping leaves near-duplicate companies, e.g. 'RPM Consultores C.A.', 'Integrador RPM Consultores C.A (Push)', 'RPM Consultores C.A (Push) 26611 Y 32421', 'RPM Engineering, C.A. / RPM Consultores C.A (Push)'. This is expected with exact normalized grouping; users can consolidate with Move. Mention it to the user.
The Cancelar button in move-app-dialog and the Guardar/Cancelar buttons in the ProjectDetail integrator editor have no data-testid.

action_items: Fix MoveAppDialog: reset q/target when the app changes or on Cancelar (e.g. useEffect on app?.integrator_id, or call the same reset in the Cancel handler).

Extend the migration contact copy: use the integrator `email` field (parse 'Name <mail>') and contacts[] when principal_contact_* is empty (runs only for orphans, so a one-off backfill script is needed for the 380 existing companies).
Add unique indexes on empresas_integradoras.rif (partial, rif not null) and norm_name; move link_orphan_integrators out of the GET list path or guard it.
CompanyFormDialog: after a successful create followed by a failed RIF upload, avoid a duplicate POST.
Make the Project Detail technician reel layout readable in the narrow column.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/integrator_companies.py GET list writes to the DB (link_orphan_integrators) on every call. This is a race risk and slow (it scans orphans every time).

ProjectDetail/DirectProjectCreation cascades group apps by integrators.name string, not by empresa_integradora_id. This works because name is synced, but it is fragile if the sync is missed (e.g. direct DB edits).
No unique index for RIF/razón social; uniqueness is enforced only at the app level.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; 1 medium UI state bug)
